# Versions of: Every tool its own website

1 published version of [Every tool its own website: turning the 49 browser tools of tools.sgraph.ai, each built because I had a problem, into sovereign websites of their own, with a theme, documentation and a small agent team each, released in waves from the simplest, with shared components pulled out, pinned versions and signed hashes kept apart, and a team of teams to keep them all moving](../every-tool-its-own-website.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
